regions.name: Abbey Grounds
regions.description: The ruined abbey of Saint Aldwyn and its surrounding outbuildings.

regions.name: Greyfen Village
regions.description: A peat-harvesting settlement along a raised causeway.

regions.name: Moorland Interior
regions.description: The windswept rises and peat bogs of the deep moor, including the standing stones.

regions.name: Harrowgate Pass
regions.description: A fog-choked defile cutting through the eastern ridge.

factions.name: The Order of the Ember Quill
factions.description: Silent monks guarding the sealed undercroft of Saint Aldwyn's Abbey.
factions.agenda: Keep the undercroft sealed, maintain the perpetual fire, watch the standing stones.

factions.name: The Greyfen Peat-Cutters
factions.description: Moorland folk who harvest peat for survival and resent the abbey's territorial claims.
factions.agenda: Secure access to the northern peat bogs, find a trade route bypassing Harrowgate.

npcs.name: Brother Maren
npcs.archetype: silent herbalist torn between vow and truth
npcs.hook: Communicates via wax tablet; may share fragments about the undercroft if trusted.

npcs.name: Warden Thessa
npcs.archetype: gaunt warden who guards a terrible secret
npcs.hook: Communicates only through terse written notes; will protect the undercroft at any cost.

npcs.name: Reeve Callum
npcs.archetype: pragmatic reeve desperate for a trade route
npcs.hook: Hires travelers for scouting; wants the northern bogs and a route past Harrowgate.

npcs.name: Fen Dysart
npcs.archetype: reckless young cutter who found buried tablets
npcs.hook: Has hidden carved tablets found near the standing stones; wants to sell them and leave.

npcs.name: Old Sem
npcs.archetype: blind hermit who speaks to the fog
npcs.hook: Claims to have crossed the pass seventeen times; guides only on his strict conditions.

npcs.name: Sister Vrenn
npcs.archetype: anxious young monk drawn to forbidden knowledge
npcs.hook: The youngest monk; has been caught trying to enter the undercroft and grows more agitated.

threads.name: The Sealed Undercroft
threads.description: Something was imprisoned beneath the abbey thirty years ago. The seals are weakening.

threads.name: The Peat War
threads.description: Greyfen needs the northern bogs the abbey claims. The truce is fraying.

threads.name: The Fog's Hunger
threads.description: Disappearances in Harrowgate are increasing. The fog may not be natural.

seeds.hint: A voice answers from below when the fire burns low.
The spirals on the buried tablets match the standing stones exactly.
The fog is a boundary, not weather. Something presses from the other side.
The Silence killed seven monks in a single night. The survivors chose muteness.
The perpetual peat fire feeds something beneath the chapter house.
Old Sem has crossed Harrowgate seventeen times. He lost his eyes on the third.
The lights at the standing stones pulse in time with the fog's thickening.
Sister Vrenn dreams of the undercroft nightly. Something is calling her.
The Old Script above the undercroft door is a warning, not a name.
The causeway is sinking. In five years Greyfen will be an island.
The solstice vigil at the stones reinforces something. Missing one weakens it.
The merchant Dysart told about the tablets entered Harrowgate and never emerged.
The monks' bell patterns encode a language more complex than their hand signs.
Ancient bones surface in the cut peat. They are not human.
The voices in the fog speak a language that sounds like the Old Script.
